report:
# Cabello integer parity and frame-function countermodel

The universal integer assignment theorem uses the actual nine source tetrads; every ray occurs twice, forcing 9=2k for an integer k, which is impossible. This is not a bounded 0/1 search. The actual normalized matrix M_bad/2 has 18 nonnegative ray values bounded by one and nine exact frame sums one, yet its quadratic value on (0,0,1,1) is -1. Source scale-four integer readouts are checked for exact divisibility before use. An explicit two-context integer assignment is a valid control, not a general sufficiency theorem. General rational-to-real transport and a full refined-carrier operad instance remain explicit formal obligations.
